intro: Financial services, government, and hospitality organisations bore the brunt of a concentrated phishing wave between 8 April and 13 May 2026, with 61 incidents logged. Threat actors Silver Fox, AccountDumpling, and Bluekit were observed exploiting vulnerabilities including CVE-2023-22515, CVE-2023-34048, CVE-2023-46805, CVE-2023-4966, and CVE-2024-21893. The campaign, composed of 53 high-severity and 8 medium-severity cases, affected targets across Latin America, the United States, Canada, and the Caribbean, alongside global operations in the cryptocurrency and technology sectors.
